about: Water names in Kansas's records that data/receiving-waters-national.json does not hold for KS: the creek Leavenworth's overflow pages name, the waters KDHE's stream advisories name and the lakes under KDHE's bloom advisories; one row per name and county (the county of the record's point, else the county it gives), with the number of reports, how many are open now, up to five of their points ([lat, lon], 0.001 degree) and the operator, so the names pass builds each name where the reports are. Records naming no water are left out (by_reason). Written by scripts/ks_report_water_names.py.
